description: The cloud LLM introduces a token «ENT_ORG_099» that was not in the original key store (hallucinated token). The decoder must leave it untouched rather than fail silently.
input_masked_text: This NDA is between «ENT_ORG_001» and «ENT_ORG_099» (an unknown party).
expected_behavior: «ENT_ORG_099» remains in the text after deterministic find-and-replace (not in key store). The pre-delivery scan fires PrivacyFilterError because «ENT_ prefix is still present.
detection: Pre-delivery scan catches the leaked «ENT_ prefix.
recovery: Hard error before write. Operator must inspect the cloud LLM response and re-run or manually resolve the unknown token.
